questions.question: In your Project Accountant role with Jacobs Engineering Group, how did you perform weekly cash counts and monthly bank reconciliations, and what steps did you take when balances did not agree?
Describe how you prepared monthly cash-flow forecasts and budget requests for the USACE-funded project. What information did you use, and how did you communicate the forecast to the home office?
You entered transactions and supporting documentation into WEBFCR daily. How did you ensure transactions were accurately coded, complete, and supported before submission?
At Allied Universal, you reviewed supplier and subcontractor invoices and payment requests. How did you determine whether an expense was reasonable, allowable, and allocable to the project?
Walk me through your process for preparing disbursement, cash, bank, and advance journal vouchers and coding payments to general ledger accounts.
Give an example of how you tracked subcontract documentation and payment confirmations from headquarters to ensure vendors or subcontractors were paid accurately and on time.

This role requires reconciliation of general ledger and balance-sheet accounts under GAAP. What reconciliation experience do you have, and how would you investigate and resolve an unexplained variance?
Describe a weekly or monthly financial report you prepared for headquarters or project leadership. What were the key figures, supporting schedules, and insights included?
How have you used Excel, Access, or other systems such as WEBFCR and IMS to organize financial data, produce reports, or improve the reliability of accounting records?

This position involves managing several client relationships and explaining financial results to non-accounting stakeholders. How would you communicate a material budget-to-actual variance to a client or manager?
